data.name: Primal Speaker
data.description: The shaman can speak with mammoths and any other megafauna or elephant creatures as if she were under the effects of speak with animals.

raw_tokens.value: The shaman can speak with mammoths and any other megafauna or elephant creatures as if she were under the effects of speak with animals.
The shaman gains a +%1 bonus on Handle Animal checks when dealing with those animals.|ShamanLVL/2|PRECLASS:1,Shaman=5

The shaman can affect one such animal within 30 feet as if she'd cast charm animal. A successful Will saving throw (DC %1) negates this effect. Whether or not the save is successful, the creature can't be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.|ShamanHexDC|PRECLASS:1,Shaman=10
